notes: North (national items + IDF, Hauts-de-France, Normandie, Bretagne, Pays de la Loire, Centre-Val de Loire, Grand Est, Bourgogne-Franche-Comté): Northern France (IDF, Hauts-de-France, Normandie, Bretagne, Pays de la Loire, Centre-Val de Loire, Grand Est, Bourgogne-Franche-Comté) plus national items. National: both animal poison centres (CNITV Lyon, CAPAE-Ouest Nantes; both 8:30–24:00, NOT 24 h), the private 3115 routing number (Emergence; free, 24/7 call centre, partial coverage). There is no public national vet-on-duty number; the Ordre's guidance is to call your own vet, who must give the duty practice. Covered with 24-h or out-of-hours emergency options: Paris & inner IDF, Lille metro, Calais, Le Touquet/Berck, Hénin-Beaumont (NAC), Amiens (day only), Rouen, Le Havre, Caen, Mont-Saint-Michel/Pontorson, Dol, Saint-Malo, Rennes, Brest, Auray, Nantes, Angers, Le Mans, Orléans, Tours, Blois, Reims, Épernay, Revigny, Strasbourg, Mulhouse/Colmar, Metz, Nancy, Dijon, Besançon. Left (not done): Lille-only clinics beyond networks, Dunkerque, Valenciennes, Arras, Beauvais/Compiègne (Oise), Saint-Quentin; Cherbourg, Évreux, Alençon, Deauville/Honfleur/Étretat coast (only aggregator results found); Quimper, Lorient, Vannes, Saint-Brieuc, Lannion; La Roche-sur-Yon, Saint-Nazaire/La Baule, Laval, Cholet; Bourges, Chartres, Châteauroux, Amboise/Chinon; Troyes, Charleville, Châlons, Épinal, Colmar town clinics; Auxerre, Beaune, Mâcon (Maison des Urgences exists, not fetched), Chalon, Nevers, Belfort/Montbéliard; IDF outer suburbs (Essonne, Yvelines beyond Vélizy); CHV des Cordeliers Meaux and Maison des Urgences Neuilly (site URL blocked by fetch provenance). Unreachable/blocked: vetonimo.fr (Nancy night centre) returned client error; maisondesurgences-neuilly.com blocked (provenance); helloasso CNITV page error. Terms: no reuse prohibition found on pages used; Ordre national directory (veterinaire.fr annuaire) is 'Tous droits réservés' and was not scraped – data come from clinics' own pages. Many 'urgences' centres in France are out-of-hours only (nights/weekends) – marked emergency_24h=false. Several 24-h flags rest on phone on-call (noted per entry). Regions given in English-free French names; CNITV region is Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes (national service). || South (Nouvelle-Aquitaine, Occitanie, PACA, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, Corse): Southern half of France (Nouvelle-Aquitaine, Occitanie, PACA, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes; Corse not covered). 60 entries: 19 marked 24 h, 1 duty rota. Covered: university hospitals Lyon (SIAMU) and Toulouse (ENVT); 24-h clinics/services in Lyon, Vaulx-Milieu, Annecy area, Grenoble, Toulouse, Perpignan, Bordeaux (Mérignac), La Rochelle, Pau, Marseille, Aix, Cannes, Nice, Saint-Laurent-du-Var; all southern V2TU out-of-hours clinics (night/weekend only, not 24 h); resort-area practices (Côte d'Azur, Saint-Tropez, Alps, Basque coast, Arcachon). Method constraints: WebFetch only allowed URLs surfaced by search or earlier fetches, and direct HTTP to vet sites was blocked by the egress proxy, so several clinics' own sites (vetriviera.fr, urgences-veterinaires-delta-06.fr, urgences-veterinaires-nice.fr, vetagro-sup info page, univet clinic pages for Nice/Lodi) could not be opened; data then came from official tourism-board listings or clinic CGF PDFs (noted per entry). No Ordre des vétérinaires regional duty rota pages were found via search; departmental garde is generally organised by clinics' answering machines. Night/weekend-only clinics are false even where a 24-h phone triage line exists (noted). Left (not done): Corse (Ajaccio, Bastia, Porto-Vecchio – only news articles/accessibility register found, no clinic page with phone opened), Limoges, Poitiers, Périgueux/Dordogne, Bayonne/Anglet clinics, Angoulême, Niort, Agen, Montauban, Albi, Béziers, Narbonne, Carcassonne, Tarbes/Lourdes, Chambéry (MonVéto page lacked a phone), Valence, Annecy town practices, Chamonix/Courchevel/Val d'Isère/Megève practices (Chamonix listing hid the phone), Menton, Antibes, Fréjus Delta83 own page, Maison des Urgences Grenoble / Alpine own pages, Vet-Urgentys satellite clinics. Terms: no registry reuse restriction encountered; Ordre national registry not used. Phone discrepancies noted on Toulon V2TU, K d'Urgence and CHV Massilia. || Independent check 2026-11-02: 68 opened (every 24-h clinic, duty rota and poison line + a random 20 % of the others), 1 fixed (Vet'Hauts de France NAC phone note), 1 downgraded to not 24 h (Urgence Vétérinaire Grenoble: hours table covers nights/weekends/holidays only), 0 removed.
